title: NAPCC National Solar Mission
definition: The Jawaharlal Nehru National Solar Mission (JNNSM) is one of the eight core missions under the National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC), launched in 2010 to establish India as a global leader in solar energy by creating policy conditions for its diffusion across the country.
importanceInUpsc: It is a cornerstone of India's Intended Nationally Determined Contributions (INDCs) under the Paris Agreement and a critical component of India's energy security and decarbonization strategy.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of NAPCC National Solar Mission.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Renewable Energy
